repository_entries.description: Pin current installation to stable v1.2.0 and record verified unified publication, compiler availability and release notes.
Record finite utility boundary audits and their remaining compatibility and service scopes.
Rewrite utility guides with short examples, visible input/output and linked API references.
Show Kafka and Data Masking composition with Logger and clarify per-call masking options.
Use Logger consistently across utility guides, references and structured output examples.
Scan isolated packaged modules for reachable Linux amd64 and arm64 vulnerabilities during CI.
Patch protobufjs reference tooling to 7.6.6 and reject known npm advisories during runtime CI.

# v1.3.0

All maintained public modules move to this version. Modules without file changes receive a version bump only.

**Scope:** 27 modules with changes; 0 version bumps only.

**Source:** [5667eb3b249c](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/powertools-lambda-go/tree/5667eb3b249c4761a13a5cb10f2a9d59988edd4a)

One project Release contains these notes; independent Go modules use matching tags at the same commit.
